definitions.explanation: The number 6,000, formed as {六|ろく} (six) × {千|せん} (1,000). No sound change occurs, unlike {六百|ろっぴゃく} (600).

examples.japanese: {六千|ろくせん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。

examples.english: Six thousand people live on this island.
Japan is said to have more than six thousand islands.

notes:
Formed as ⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧ × ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧. Note the contrast with the hundreds: ⟦{六百|ろっぴゃく}→六百：30450_roppyaku⟧ changes sound, but {六千|ろくせん} does not.

SOUND CHANGES IN THE THOUSANDS:
- ⟦{三千|さんぜん}→三千：00985_sanzen⟧: 3,000 — せん voices to ぜん
- ⟦{八千|はっせん}→八千：30471_hassen⟧: 8,000 — はち shortens to はっ
- ⟦{一千|いっせん}→一千：30472_issen⟧: 1,000 — いち shortens to いっ
- ⟦{四千|よんせん}→四千：30474_yonsen⟧, ⟦{五千|ごせん}→五千：30470_gosen⟧, {六千|ろくせん}, ⟦{七千|ななせん}→七千：30476_nanasen⟧, ⟦{九千|きゅうせん}→九千：30477_kyuusen⟧: regular

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {六千|ろくせん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: six thousand yen
- {六千|ろくせん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: six thousand people
- {六千|ろくせん}⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: six thousand years ago
